title: runspec.toml
description: Interface specification for anything runnable — scripts, apps, MCP tools. See https://runspec.app

autonomy_level.description: How much agent autonomy is permitted. Most restrictive level wins when multiple apply.

enforce_run_as.description: On the direct/import execution path, how to react when the process is not running as the resolved run_as user. 'error' (default) refuses to run; 'warn' logs and continues; 'off' disables the check. No-op when run_as is empty or on a platform with no POSIX uid model.

config.description: Project-wide defaults. The only reserved top-level key — all other keys are runnable names.

autonomy-default.description: Default autonomy level for runnables that don't declare one.

enforce_run_as.description: Default enforce_run_as for runnables that don't declare one.

name.description: MCP server name reported by runspec serve. Defaults to the venv directory name.

logging.description: When present, the language pack configures structured logging automatically on parse().

rotate.description: Log rotation policy: a time keyword (midnight, daily, weekly) or a size like '10 MB'.

keep.description: Number of rotated log files to keep.

summary.description: Write a structured run-summary record (duration, exit code, per-level event counts) to the audit log after each run. This is the data the console history/analytics tabs and 'runspec logs' read.

summary_console.description: Also echo a one-line human-readable summary to the terminal (stderr) at exit. Off by default so stdout stays clean for pipes and the line is never tagged ERROR by stream-classifying log processors (e.g. Rundeck). Enable for interactive use.

store.description: Log file layout. 'single' = one rotating {runnable}.log per runnable (default). 'per-run' = one {runnable}.{utc-ts}.{run_id}.log per invocation — multi-writer safe (no in-process rotation; use 'runspec logs' to view/compact/prune).

jump-hosts.description: Named jump host aliases for runspec jump. Each key is an alias name.

runspec_env.description: Path to a .runspec_env file (KEY=VALUE dotenv format). Loaded at parse time; existing env vars win. Relative paths resolve from sys.prefix. Per-runnable runspec_env wins over this setting.

jump_host.description: A target host for runspec jump.

host.description: Hostname or IP address to SSH to.

user.description: SSH username. Defaults to the current user.

ssh-key.description: Path to the SSH private key file.

bin.description: Path to the runspec binary on the remote host.

ssh-options.description: Extra arguments passed to the SSH command (e.g. ["-o", "StrictHostKeyChecking=no"]).

jump-host.description: ProxyJump alias — route through another named jump-host entry.

runnable.description: A runnable tool — a script, application, or MCP tool described by this file.

description.description: Human and agent readable description of what this tool does.

autonomy-reason.description: Explanation of why this autonomy level was chosen.

output.description: Declares what the runnable writes to stdout. Surfaces as x-output in emitted schemas.

serve.description: Controls whether runspec serve exposes this runnable as an MCP tool. true/false or a list of contexts ('local', 'remote').

oneOf.description: true (default) — always exposed; false — never exposed.
Expose only in the listed serve contexts. 'local' = not over SSH; 'remote' = over SSH.

discoverable.description: Whether this runnable is listed by runspec serve/local. true (default) — visible; false — hidden from all discovery surfaces (an internal helper, still runnable when invoked directly). Orthogonal to serve. A false value surfaces as x-discoverable in emitted schemas.

hosts.description: Restrict this runnable to specific hostnames. Absent means available everywhere it is installed.

become_method.description: Privilege escalation method used when run_as is set.

become_flags.description: Optional flags passed to the become method (e.g. "-H" for sudo).

description.description: Optional explanation shown alongside the example.

args.description: Argument definitions. Each value is a bare default (type inferred) or a full arg definition.

groups.description: Argument group constraints (exclusive, inclusive, at-least-one, exactly-one, conditional).

require-command.description: When true, invoking this runnable without naming one of its commands errors with the list of available commands (like argparse add_subparsers(required=True)).

commands.description: Subcommands. Each key is a subcommand name with its own args, groups, autonomy, and description.

runspec_env.description: Path to a .runspec_env file for this runnable. Overrides [config] runspec_env. Relative paths resolve from sys.prefix.

run_as.description: The OS user to run the command as on the remote host.

oneOf.description: Username or environment variable reference (e.g. "oracle" or "$ORACLE_RUN_AS").

default.description: Fallback user when no host or pattern matches. Empty string means no escalation.

hosts.description: Exact hostname → username mapping. Empty string means no escalation on that host.

patterns.description: Regex pattern → username mapping. Evaluated top-to-bottom, first match wins.

arg_value.description: A bare default value (type inferred) or a full argument definition object.

oneOf.description: Bare boolean — inferred as flag type with this default.
Bare integer — inferred as int type with this default.
Bare float — inferred as float type with this default.
Bare string — inferred as str type with this default.

arg_def.description: Full argument definition (inline table or full [runnable.args.name] block).

type.description: Argument type. Inferred from default or options if omitted. 'password' marks a secret: masked in UIs, refused on the command line, omitted from agent schemas, and kept out of logs.

default.description: Default value. Absence implies required = true (unless required is explicitly set).

required.description: Whether the argument is required. Inferred from missing default if omitted.

description.description: Human and agent readable description. Doubles as a form label.

options.description: Valid choices. Infers type = "choice" when present.

range.description: Valid range for numeric types: [min, max].

pattern.description: Regex the value must fully match (re.fullmatch semantics). str type only.

min-length.description: Minimum string length. str type only.

max-length.description: Maximum string length. str type only.

multiple.description: Accept multiple values (repeated --flag style). Serialised as newline-delimited in RUNSPEC_* env vars.

delimiter.description: Split a single value by this delimiter (e.g. "," for --fields a,b,c).

short.description: Short flag alias (e.g. "-v"). -h is reserved for --help.

position.description: 1-based positional index. Makes the arg positional rather than a --flag. Must be unique within a runnable.

env.description: Environment variable fallback(s). Checked after RUNSPEC_<RUNNABLE>_ARG_* and before the spec default.

deprecated.description: Deprecation message shown when this arg is used.

autonomy.description: Per-arg autonomy override. Escalates to this level if more restrictive than the runnable level.

ui.description: Form control hint. Inferred from type and properties if omitted.

hint.description: Placeholder / hint text shown in a UI form field (e.g. an example value). Advisory for str/path/password types; never affects parsing or validation.

meta.description: Developer-defined metadata. Pass-through — runspec never interprets the contents.

args.description: List of arg names in this group (used by exclusive, inclusive, at-least-one, exactly-one).

exclusive.description: At most one arg from the group may be provided.

inclusive.description: If any arg is provided, all must be provided.

at-least-one.description: One or more args from the group must be provided.

exactly-one.description: Strictly one arg from the group must be provided.

if.description: Trigger arg for a conditional group — when this arg is provided, requires are enforced.

requires.description: Args that become required when the 'if' trigger arg is provided.

autonomy-reason.description: Explanation of why this autonomy level was chosen.

output.description: Declares what this subcommand writes to stdout.

groups.description: Argument group constraints for this subcommand.

require-command.description: When true, invoking this subcommand without naming one of its nested commands errors with the list of available commands (like argparse add_subparsers(required=True)).
